_: What the studio says to a child when it cannot show feedback. Keyed by the class language; English is the fallback. These are the only words a child hears from the harness itself; everything else comes from a skill.

en.storage_failed: The course could not be saved. Your drawing is still here; please check local storage and retry.
en.cancelled: Stopped. Your drawing is still here.
en.unsafe: Let us try a different picture together.
en.sketch_unsupported: I could not reliably build all the forms in this drawing. Try a head study, or a tabletop study with boxes, spheres, upright cylinders, pears, apples or oranges. Your drawing is still here.
en.portrait_unavailable: The head-building tool is not ready right now. Your drawing is still here; please try again shortly.
en.fruit_mesh_unavailable: The fruit-building tool is not ready right now. Your drawing is still here; please try again shortly.
en.sketch_invalid: The forms did not come together this time. Try this drawing again; the original is still here.
en.empty: I do not see a drawing on this page yet. Send me a photo of the drawing.
en.block: This does not look like a drawing. Send me a picture of some artwork.
en.hiccup: Something went wrong on my side. Try that photo again in a moment.
en.gate: Something went wrong. Try that photo again in a moment.
en.not_open: That part of the studio is not open yet.
en.no_opening: The conversation has not opened yet. Let the studio look at this drawing and ask the first question, then type what the child said.
en.said_back_colour: You said: “{words}”. And then what happened?
en.said_back_sketch: You said: “{words}”. Which part would you like to try first?
en.opening_fallback_colour: I can see your picture. Tell me, what did you draw?
en.opening_fallback_sketch: I can see your drawing. Which part took the most thought?
en.rung_fallback_colour: Which part of the picture would you like to talk about first?
en.rung_fallback_sketch: Which part of the drawing would you like to talk about first?
en.busy: The studio is very full right now. Give me a moment and try again.
en.draft_review_failed: The draft did not pass review against the drawing or confirmed content. It is kept for editing; regenerate and pass review before confirming.
en.scene_review_advice: The description was written again and the check still has notes on it. They are advice only: the description is yours to confirm, edit or write again.
en.draft_unusable: This time the words did not come out right. Press again to write them anew.
en.figure_held_back: The 3D figure did not come out well enough to show this time. Your painting is still here, and we can try again.
en.clip_held_back: The clip showed something that is not in the painting, so it was not shown. Your painting is still here; press again to make a new version.
en.session_gone: This course was opened again in another window, so the work here stopped. Reload the page, or open the course again from the course list.
en.bridge: I heard you! Let me look at your drawing again.
en.bridge_tail: Let me look at your drawing again.
en.book_picture_held_back: One page's new picture did not pass its check, so it is not shown. Try another style, or make the book of the originals.
en.book_pictures_missing: The pages in this style are not drawn yet. Choose the style again to draw them.

zh.storage_failed: 课程暂时没能保存。原画还在，请检查本机存储后重试。
zh.unsafe: 我们一起换一幅画试试吧。
zh.sketch_unsupported: 这幅画里的形体还不能全部可靠地搭出来。可以试试头像，或方体、球体、直立圆柱体与梨、苹果、橙子的桌面静物素描，原画还在这里。
zh.portrait_unavailable: 头像重建暂时还没有准备好，原画还在这里。稍后可以再试一次。
zh.fruit_mesh_unavailable: 水果重建暂时还没有准备好，原画还在这里。稍后可以再试一次。
zh.sketch_invalid: 这次没能把形体搭好。可以再试一次，原画还在这里。
zh.empty: 这一页上我还没看到画呢。把画拍给我看看吧。
zh.block: 这看起来不像一幅画。给我看一张画好吗？
zh.hiccup: 我这边出了点小问题。过一会儿再把这张照片发给我吧。
zh.gate: 出了点小问题。过一会儿再试试这张照片吧。
zh.not_open: 画室的这一部分还没有开门。
zh.no_opening: 这幅画还没有开场。先让画画伙伴看看这幅画、问出第一句，再把孩子说的话打进来。
zh.said_back_colour: 你说：“{words}”。然后呢，发生了什么？
zh.said_back_sketch: 你说：“{words}”。你想先从哪一部分试起？
zh.opening_fallback_colour: 我看到你的画啦。跟我说说，你画了什么呀？
zh.opening_fallback_sketch: 我看到你的画啦。你画的时候，哪一部分最花心思？
zh.rung_fallback_colour: 你最想先说画里的哪一部分？
zh.rung_fallback_sketch: 你最想先说这幅画的哪一部分？
zh.transcribe_prompt: 以下是简体中文的普通话句子。
zh.busy: 画室现在有点挤。稍等一下再试试吧。
zh.draft_review_failed: 草稿复核未通过，可能与原画或已确认内容不一致。草稿已保留供修改，请重新生成并通过复核后再确认。
zh.scene_review_advice: 描述已经重写过，复核对这一版还有意见，仅供参考：可以直接确认，也可以修改或再写一次。
zh.draft_unusable: 这次没有写好。再按一次，重新写一版。
zh.figure_held_back: 这次的立体小雕塑没有做好，先不拿出来。原画还在这里，可以再试一次。
zh.clip_held_back: 短片里出现了画里没有的东西，这次先不拿出来。原画还在这里，再按一次会做一个新的版本。
zh.session_gone: 这门课在别的窗口又被打开了一次，这里的任务已经停下。请刷新页面，或从课程列表重新进入这门课。
zh.bridge: 我听到啦！让我再好好看看你的画。
zh.bridge_tail: 让我再仔细看看你的画。
zh.book_picture_held_back: 有一页的新画没有通过检查，先不拿出来。可以换一种风格，或者用原画做书。
zh.book_pictures_missing: 这个风格的画还没有画好。再选一次这个风格，把它们画出来。
